ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65-70% high-intensity (white) pixels and 30-35% low-intensity (black/dark) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous low-intensity dark blob centered at the basal notch area extending symmetrically into both lobes. Scattered low-intensity mottling and focal spots concentrated along the lateral margins and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits more pronounced peaks with an amplitude of approximately 8-12 pixels compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning into sharp concave sweeps towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast dark pixels observed at the extreme outer tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface irregularities.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical dark linear pixel disruption on the lower-left lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the horizontal axis of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent reddish-brown protruding mass or lesion visible on the far right distal tip, creating a distinct break in the fluke's geometric contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Diffuse yellowish-brown staining or bio-film accumulation visible on the upper-inner quadrant of the left lobe.
